quote: Our hearts are restless until they rest in God.
To love is to will the good of another.
Start by doing what is necessary, then what is possible.
Patience obtains all things.
Do not be afraid.
Pray, hope, and do not worry.
Holiness is found in small acts of love.
Go forth and set the world on fire.
Be who God meant you to be.
Listen carefully with the ear of your heart.
